caseName: Going v. Norfolk & Western Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Willie M. Going, Administratrix of Nathan W. Going v. Norfolk & Western Railway Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of Appeals of the State of Virginia.
attorneys: Mr. W. L. Welborn for plaintiff in error. Mr. Waller R. Staples, Mr. Theodore W. Reath and Mr. Roy B. Smith for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Affirmed upon the authority of Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Padgett, 236 U. S. 668, 673; Great Northern Ry. Co. v. Knapp, 240 U. S. 464, 466; Southern Ry. Co. v. Puckett, 244 U. S. 571, 574. See also Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul Ry. Co. v. O’Connor, ante, 536.
